single_changed_variable: overlapping proposal tickets are converted into one same-pair inventory episode
inventory_rules: first contained V11 signal opens one fixed 1/7 NAV pair sleeve
same-direction signal while open is recorded but does not add or extend age
opposite signal closes at its executable open and opens the new direction at that same recorded open
unchanged episode exits at its source fixed H384 BID/ASK close
all remaining inventory is liquidated and marked at the period end
period_membership: only source proposals whose fill and fixed H384 exit are inside the period; each period is independently flat-start and terminal-liquidated
development_admission: normal and adverse full walk equity multiples exceed 1.0
normal and adverse individual month equity multiples exceed 1.0
terminal inventory is zero in every arm and period
final_acceptance: not available from opened development; untouched full months must reach at least 2.0x in normal and adverse
